findings.message: buscarListas takes a name fragment but no state holds it; added public state busca (default '', published by buscarListas, reset on every entry).

selectedLista holds only the id from entry.params.listaId and no request fetches one lista; added public selectLista(id|null) that resolves the row from the loaded listas, fills salvarListaDraft and reports client.selectionInvalid; added getter formularioLista returning the selected row.

criarLista and salvarLista have no <command>.input state; added criarListaDraft and salvarListaDraft with setCriarListaDraft and setSalvarListaDraft. The new-lista draft starts with ativa = true (a new list receives tasks by default) instead of null.

criarLista and salvarLista return lista but no state has it as source; applied as an upsert by id in listas (a new row is appended at the end, not sorted by name, and is not checked against the current busca filter). pageStatus is not rewritten after a command, so it stays 'empty' if the first lista is created on an empty page; the page should rely on listas.length or reload through listarListas.
